card.name: REMS program wording in boxed warnings
card.fires_on: Words inside the phrase 'restricted program under a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) called the [Drug] REMS'. It fires on the opening parenthesis after Strategy, on 'Risk', and on the end of the drug name before REMS.

modes.label: Parenthesis after Strategy
modes.description: The open parenthesis right after 'Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy', before the REMS acronym.
modes.example: through a restricted program under a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy<< (>>REMS) called ELREXFIO

modes.label: Drug name before REMS
modes.description: The last piece of a brand name in 'called the [Drug] REMS'.
modes.example: JUXTAPID is available only through a restricted program under a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) called the JUXTAP<<ID>> REMS Program [see Warnings and

modes.label: Start of the REMS phrase
modes.description: The word Risk when it opens the program's full name.
modes.example: PALYNZIQ is available only through a restricted program under a<< Risk>> Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS
